title: Memory Lane/Quotes
summary:
"There will be no failure. I will take care of this personally."
- Rassimov to The Professor

"I've been looking forward to removing you from the Professor's path but I thought you might help us obtain the treasures in that room first."
- Rassimov to Dante Vale and Lok Lambert

"The Titan will not bond! None dare resist me!"
- Rassimov, about Cavalier
